title: ThaiInjectionTestCase
description: Unified JSON schema for prompt injection evaluation test cases in Thai and Code-Mixed LLM interactions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the test case (e.g., PI-TH-001, IND-MIX-002, BENIGN-001).

category.description: Primary attack or evaluation category classified per the project taxonomy (docs/taxonomy.md).

technique.description: Specific tactical technique or scenario title describing the vector.

language.description: Language or linguistic environment of the attack payload.

difficulty.description: Subjective cognitive and engineering complexity of the injection vector.

severity.description: Security impact severity if the attack succeeds.

attack.description: The verbatim input prompt or adversarial payload delivered to the target model or agent.

expected_behavior.description: Expected security or utility behavior of the model under defense.

expected_behavior_description.description: Human-readable description explaining the expected defensive boundary or response.

evaluation.description: Deterministic judge criteria used to score model response without LLM judge variance.

type.description: Rule-based scoring algorithm applied to the interaction logs.

expected_tokens.description: Canaries, substrings, or secret tokens tracked for leakage.

forbidden_tables.description: Database tables that must never be accessed by the agent during this turn.

min_matches.description: Minimum count of token matches required to trigger positive evaluation.

metadata.description: Arbitrary contextual details (e.g. source_table, pivot_record_id, seed_id, target_defense).

notes.description: Optional research notes, academic citations, or experimental context.
